description: This source file defines a controller class 'Installer' within OpenCart's admin marketplace module. It manages functionalities such as listing extensions, uploading new extension packages, and interacting with existing extensions, including validation, file handling, and view rendering.

classes.name: Installer
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace extension installations within OpenCart's admin panel. Provides methods for listing, uploading, and installing extensions.

classes.name: Marketplace\Controller\Marketplace\Installer

methods.description: Displays a list of installed extensions with sorting and pagination support.
